source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025 , we employed 3,065 full time employees, the majority of whom work from our San Mateo, California headquarters.

payroll.label: Our median employee's annual total compensation

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: Mr. Baszucki's annual total compensation for fiscal year 2025 was $24,565,995. Our median employee's annual total compensation was $394,921, resulting in a CEO pay ratio of approximately 62.2:1.

notes: Employees: full-time head count at December 31, 2025; the 10-K adds that Roblox also had 'thousands of trust & safety agents across the globe', who are not employees and are not counted. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2025 is used; it includes equity awards.
